Kia ora, Facebook! 👋

We're new to Facebook, but we're not new to health.

RWR Health connects nurses, carers, clinicians and health leaders with workplaces where they can do their best work, across New Zealand and Australia. We're part of RWR Group, with more than 25 years of specialist recruitment behind us. 💙

Here's what you can expect from this page:
💙 New roles across health and care
🩺 Career advice for health professionals
📋 Hiring insights for health employers
🙌 Stories and reviews from the people we work with
